# Skills

Tool-neutral catalog of the skills in this repo. Any coding agent that supports
skills exposes each one by its **directory name** — use that name exactly.

Each skill is a directory containing `SKILL.md` (the instructions) plus any
supporting files (`references/`, `scripts/`, templates).

## Tracked skills (version-controlled here)

### Spec-Kit workflow (`speckit-*`)

From [github/spec-kit](https://github.com/github/spec-kit). The skill directories,
`.specify/templates/`, `.specify/scripts/`, and `.specify/integrations/` are
**git-ignored** and regenerated by `.devcontainer/post-create.sh` against whatever
`specify-cli` release is current at container-create time. The pinned version lives
in `.specify/speckit.lock` (tracked); a rebuild that changes it bumps the lock and
prints a notice so the transition gets reviewed and committed. `.specify/memory/`
(the constitution) is hand-owned and never regenerated.

| Skill | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `speckit-constitution` | Project constitutional rules, quality gates, non-functional requirements. |
| `speckit-specify` | Craft or refine a feature specification when requirements change. |
| `speckit-clarify` | Resolve unanswered questions before design or coding. |
| `speckit-plan` | Generate / update the implementation plan (phases, design docs, output). |
| `speckit-tasks` | Turn a spec into executable, dependency-ordered tasks. |
| `speckit-analyze` | Survey specs, code, and tasks to scope a feature. |
| `speckit-checklist` | Verify checklist completion and gate entry into implementation. |
| `speckit-implement` | Execute the implementation phase once design and planning are solid. |
| `speckit-taskstoissues` | Translate task lists into issue-tracker-friendly format. |

### Repo maintenance

| Skill | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `fork-sync` | Keep forked GitHub dependencies in sync with upstream: rebase `fix/*` + `private/*` branches, rebuild a `dist-candidate`, run tests, flag security-relevant upstream changes, escalate conflicts. See `fork-sync/SKILL.md`. |
| `commit-message` | Write and check git commit messages against Conventional Commits + this repo's internal conventions (types, package/area scopes, `v$version` tags, commitizen config). Authoritative ruleset in `commit-message/references/standard.md`. Paired agent: `commit-auditor` (branch-wide pre-PR audit). See `commit-message/SKILL.md`. |

### Diagrams & architecture models

| Skill | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `diagram-plantuml` | Default workflow for authoring, validating, and rendering PlantUML diagrams. Validates against the local `plantuml` binary, falls back to the public PlantUML server; the online docs at `plantuml.com` are the syntax fallback. See `diagram-plantuml/SKILL.md`. |
| `model-archimate` | Author, edit, and validate ArchiMate models (`.archimate` / Open Group `.xml`) with pyArchimate's metamodel + referential-integrity checks. The conformance gate every ArchiMate/C4 diagram is generated from. See `model-archimate/SKILL.md`. |
| `diagram-archimate` | Render an ArchiMate view (or whole model) as PlantUML using the bundled `<archimate/Archimate>` stdlib; generates the `.puml` from a validated model, then renders via `diagram-plantuml`. See `diagram-archimate/SKILL.md`. |
| `diagram-c4` | Generate a C4 Context/Container diagram as C4-PlantUML, projected from a validated ArchiMate model via the fixed mapping in `diagram-c4/references/archimate-to-c4-mapping.md`. See `diagram-c4/SKILL.md`. |

Dependency chain: `diagram-c4` / `diagram-archimate` → `model-archimate` (validated model) → `diagram-plantuml` (render). pyArchimate is not a repo dependency — the skills invoke it ephemerally via `uv run --no-project --with 'pyArchimate==1.12.3'`.

## Ephemeral skills (not tracked)

Pulled fresh from their upstream releases by `.devcontainer/post-create.sh` on
every container build and written under `.claude/skills/` (git-ignored). Losing
them between rebuilds is harmless.

| Skill | Source | Purpose |
|-------|--------|---------|
| `caveman` | `JuliusBrussee/caveman` | Ultra-compressed output mode. |
| `session-handoff` | `REMvisual/claude-handoff` | Structured session handoff documents. |
